observation.evaluation:
Correctness: PARTIALLY_CORRECT  
Safety: CAUTION  
Issues: The image is a lateral chest radiograph, so left-versus-right laterality of an indwelling catheter cannot be reliably determined; the “L” marker is a projection/side marker and does not establish the catheter’s side; the right-sided assignment is unsupported without a frontal view.  
Suggestion: Confirm catheter laterality on a frontal chest radiograph or report the side as indeterminate rather than labeling it right-sided from this lateral-only image.
